messages.author: ab1a9561c155f455
messages.subject: INLA error package
parts:
Good morning, I used R-INLA in previous analyses,
today I tried to run it and I can't, even updating
the packages and Cran, could you help me?

formula <- Y ~ index + f(re_u, model = "besag", graph = g) + f(re_v, model = "iid") > res <- inla(formula, family = "poisson", data = map@data, E = E, + control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE)) Error in model.frame.default(new.fix.formula, data.same.len, na.action = inla.na.action) : tipo inválido (list) para variável 'index' *** inla.core.safe: inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2 Error in model.frame.default(new.fix.formula, data.same.len, na.action = inla.na.action) : tipo inválido (list) para variável 'index' *** inla.core.safe: inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=2/2 Error in model.frame.default(new.fix.formula, data.same.len, na.action = inla.na.action) : tipo inválido (list) para variável 'index' Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
